title: 环形链表

en.title: Linked List Cycle
constraints: pos is -1 or a valid index in the list

complexity.space: Fast/slow pointers: O(1) extra space; an O(n) hash set also passes
complexity.officialRequirement: Official follow-up asks to use only O(1) (constant) extra memory.
complexity.notes: n is the number of nodes. Floyd's cycle detection: the fast pointer moves two steps and the slow one step at a time; if there is a cycle they must meet inside it, and the fast pointer takes at most about 2n steps. The largest test is the official limit n = 10000.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is the node count n; line 2 has n integers, the list values; line 3 is pos (the index the tail links to, -1 for no cycle). stdout: true or false.

constraints: pos 为 -1 或链表中的合法下标

complexity.space: 快慢指针 O(1) 额外空间；哈希集合 O(n) 亦可通过
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方 follow-up 要求仅用 O(1)（常数）额外内存。
complexity.notes: n 为节点数。Floyd 判圈：快指针每次走两步、慢指针走一步，有环则必在环内相遇，快指针最多走约 2n 步。最大测试为官方上限 n = 10000。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行节点数 n；第二行 n 个整数表示链表值；第三行 pos（尾节点连向的下标，-1 表示无环）。stdout：true 或 false。
